residual_risks.RR1: The global failed-code throttle of ADR 0020 is shared by every user, so anyone submitting wrong codes can delay legitimate redemption and signup for everyone; the decision accepts this, and only p9-ratelimit's threshold tuning limits it.
residual_risks.RR2: Kit deletion and retention reductions do not reach the 30-day backups, which may conflict with the consent promise of deletion at any time; no decision covers it (Q2).
residual_risks.RR3: Whether `device_sessions` rows for logging-off kits count as stored activity under CLAUDE.md rule 2 is undecided (Q1).
residual_risks.RR4: The generated phase files and `build_plan.py` disagree with the amended beads (p6-ingest clamping, p7-quiz A/B/C, p9-privacy-doc's dependency, p6-client and p7-live-stuck alert path); a reader who skips CLAUDE.md and the README amendment map can build the old rule.
residual_risks.RR5: The retention tiers of ADR 0023 have not been checked against the research approval (jade-bi5 open), and `facilitator_notes` keep adult free text with its class indefinitely after retention.
residual_risks.RR6: Two mitigations had no implementing bead (duplicate-join visibility, a bounded and rate-limited live alert store); 5.8 files them under the Phase 7 epic jade-7s7, a phase this plan proposes and Mike confirms (Q7), and the new beads carry only a title until Phase 7 planning scopes them.
residual_risks.RR7: Editing the handoff data docs in place means the files no longer match `jade-handoff.zip`; the banner and commit 079e846 keep the original reachable.
residual_risks.RR8: After the p10-backups restore drill, the staging VM holds a copy of production adult PII and kit-level data, and the production backup key has been used there; no source says when it is wiped, so kit deletions and retention do not reach it either (Q8).
residual_risks.RR9: A scanned QR leaves the plain kit code in the adult device's browser history; no bead addresses it, and only single-use redemption (jade-7if) limits its value (Q9).
